changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldValue_bak') BEGIN drop table [dbo].[FieldValue_bak] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldValue_bak') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldValue_bak]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](250) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FieldValue] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FieldValue_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldValue_bak] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldValue_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldValue_bak] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldValue_FieldType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldValue_ObjectTypeObjectIDFieldTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldValue_ObjectTypeObjectIDFieldTypeID] ON [dbo].[FieldValue_bak] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [FieldTypeID] ASC ) END
